provenance: Invented synthetic records for a writing exercise, not measurements of real software or historical experimental evidence.
common_contract: A and B are hypothetical implementations of the same Boolean computation, with the same input/output ownership, static passive corruption target, two concurrent parties on the same hypothetical hardware, and fresh ideal correlations per execution. These declared settings are not verified security claims.
timer_contract: Each record describes one continuous total wall interval, from start of setup through final output. Setup and online are contiguous disjoint subintervals covering that total; online includes the required final check and output handling. Party work overlaps inside each interval. No arithmetic sum of party-local timers is used.
communication_contract: Online payload counts only. Sum the two parties' sends once for aggregate bidirectional payload. Receives, setup traffic, framing, and transport overhead are excluded. No broadcast is used.

records.name: A
records.reported_byte_aggregation: maximum of the two directional send totals

records.name: B
records.reported_byte_aggregation: sum of both directional send totals

limitations: One invented record per variant. No repetitions, dispersion, raw instrument logs, correctness tests, source code, concrete-security calibration, or explanation isolating the cause of a difference is supplied. No setup communication value is supplied.
